status: READY FOR ART REVIEW; user aesthetic approval separate

motion.source: 300 unmodified actual Godot runtime PNG frames per clip, H264 encoded through native AVFoundation
motion.limits: Sampled frame inspection, not proof of entire-clip smooth playback or every angle. Inspection pan/zoom/yaw is scripted; gameplay controls remain fixed orientation.

excluded_performance.baseline_performance.json / final_perfor: Initial window measurements; desktop focus/timing conditions did not reliably match.
excluded_performance.baseline_recheck_performance.json / fina: Focus and live-input conditions were not isolated. No valid incremental cost claim.
excluded_performance.baseline_controlled_performance.json / f: No-focus request did not reliably fix desktop focus across runs.
excluded_performance.baseline_offscreen_performance.json / fi: Unsupported root.hide() call produced an error. Excluded, not accepted evidence.

experiments.continuous/radiance/horizon/ripple/warpe: Progressive actual-render trials; final resources only are accepted.
experiments.shallow_base: Incomplete capture timed out; bottom -3.5 conflicts with existing height floor -4. Original geometry restored.
experiments.probe_water: Once-mode probe did not give useful geometry reflection, altered ambient response and leaked seven texture RIDs on shutdown. Removed.
experiments.offscreen_harness: Initial type-inference parse failure corrected; unsupported root.hide corrected; one accidentally overlapping baseline job stopped and excluded. Clean isolated pair has no overlap.

media_storage: PNG/MP4 remain local ignored review artifacts, not repository source. Manifests and reproducible harness are tracked.
